page.layout: One page of text: title block centred at the top, then dedicatory salutation, then body paragraph beginning with a woodcut initial; a signature mark "A 2" at the foot. No margin notes. Library stamp and digitiser mark are omitted.

main_text.l: Et Serenissimo Principi CAROLO II. Magnæ
Britanniæ, Franciæ, & Hiberniæ Regi, è secre-
HI curti in Tempora commentarii, urbem pera-

l.i: nium ambiunt. Non quòd tenues adeò tam
cœleste & sacrum in subjectum conatus tanti
tamq; sacri Nominis auctoritate defendi mereantur,
sed tantummodo quòd ipsum subjectum Sacrum sit revera

main_text.l: & Cœleste. Cœleste quidem idcirco quòd Tempora quibus
distinguendis operam hic locamus, ab ipsis cœlorum
motibus ortum pariter ac progressum acceperunt, cum iisdem
etiam peritura. E Sacris autem eadem habenda
esse, unanimis omnium gentium & seculorum omnium
[Initial word "HI" is the woodcut initial "I" joined to "curti"; read as "Hi curti" is not certain, see notes.]

page.notes: The first word is a large woodcut initial (likely I); marked as doubtful. Strikethrough on "urbem" in the first line of the body is shown as overprinted "urbem" in italic in the transcription. Library oval stamp (Biblioteca Nazionale, Roma) and Google digitiser mark are omitted. Text is partly faint and blotted at the right margin of the body.
